name: ES Passive Absorption Paradox v1
instrument: ES transaction-flow signal executed with one MES using recorded MBP-1 quotes
source: Databento GLBX.MDP3 ES trades, ES one-minute OHLCV, and MES MBP-1
hypothesis: When the 15:00-15:30 price move and net aggressor flow have opposite signs, price has moved despite pressure from aggressive traders in the other direction. The passive side is controlling the clearing price, the opposing aggressors are poorly positioned, and the price direction should persist through the final half hour.

eligibility.entry_and_exit_quotes: finite, positive, non-crossed recorded MBP-1 bid and ask
eligibility.spread_filter: none; cross the recorded spread regardless of its width

signal.signed_flow: ES buyer-aggressor volume minus seller-aggressor volume
signal.zero_rule: no trade if price move or signed flow is zero
signal.interpretation: trade with the price direction that overcame opposing aggressive flow

execution.entry_time: first recorded MES MBP-1 quote at or after 15:30:05 ET
execution.stop: none; one MES and a fixed approximately 29-minute holding period bound exposure
execution.exit_time: first recorded MES MBP-1 quote at or after 15:59:45 ET
execution.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

economics.slippage_model: the full recorded MES bid-ask spread is crossed at entry and exit; no additional modeled slippage

lesson: Local price moving against aggressor flow showed economically interesting passive-control information in 2021-2022, but it was too sparse and reversed in 2023. The mechanism may be episodic rather than a stable near-daily engine. The flow window, direction, and magnitude must not be altered to rescue it on observed data.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was not evaluated because the unchanged rule failed frequency and cross-year development gates.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: flipping the signal to follow aggressor flow
using the full-session return instead of the frozen local price move
weekday, volatility, volume, or regime filters
changing either execution timestamp after observing results
